Commercial and Industrial in Norwich and Norfolk

We take on commercial and industrial electrical work across Norfolk, from 3 phase distribution boards in Norwich city centre to a back up generator in Twyford and a farm shop new build.

Call 07576 485671 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

With many years in the electrical and construction industry, across domestic, commercial and industrial settings, we have picked up skills and experience that help on all kinds of jobs. We always tidy up after ourselves and keep the working area safe and tidy, which matters as much in a workplace as in a home.

Why We Like This Work

In Gary's words: "Commercial works as it allows us to try out our experiences and knowledge." We also work alongside builders, and like getting to know different sites and different people.

Three Phase Work

Two of our recent jobs were 3 phase distribution boards in Norwich: one relocated and replaced in the city centre this year, one upgraded last year. In Twyford we installed a 3 phase back up generator.
